name: dora-electron
description: DoraMCU Desktop - Multi-Universe Tabletop RPG Platform
author: DoraMCU Team

scripts.copy-jar: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const libs=path.join(__dirname,'..','build','libs');if(fs.existsSync(libs)){const jar=fs.readdirSync(libs).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.jar')&&!f.endsWith('.sources.jar')&&!f.endsWith('.javadoc.jar')&&!f.includes('-plain.jar')).sort((a,b)=>{try{const sa=fs.statSync(path.join(libs,a)).size;const sb=fs.statSync(path.join(libs,b)).size;return sb-sa;}catch{return 0;}})[0];if(jar){const dest=path.join(__dirname,'server');if(!fs.existsSync(dest))fs.mkdirSync(dest,{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(path.join(libs,jar),path.join(dest,jar));console.log('Copied',jar,'to server/');}else console.warn('No executable JAR found in build/libs');}else console.warn('build/libs not found, run gradle bootJar first')"
